statements: given $new_purchase_id: string, $expected_item_id: string, $expected_buyer_id: string; match $item isa! item; $buyer isa! account; $item has stock $stock; $stock isa! stock; $buyer has balance $balance; $balance isa! balance; $item has price $price; $price isa! price; $item has item-id $item_key; $item_key isa! item-id; $buyer has id $buyer_key; $buyer_key isa! id; $item_key == $expected_item_id; $buyer_key == $expected_buyer_id; $stock > 0; $balance >= $price; let $next_stock = ($stock - 1); let $next_balance = ($balance - $price); update $item has stock == $next_stock; $buyer has balance == $next_balance; insert $purchase isa purchase, links (buyer: $buyer, item: $item), has purchase-id == $new_purchase_id; select $purchase;
